completion: I'm glad you noticed instead of just guessing — but this is really one to run past your prescriber or a pharmacist, since the right move depends on which SSRI and your dose, and they can tell you in a two-minute phone call. The one thing I'd say generally is don't take a double dose to "catch up," and don't stop it abruptly on your own. If you can't reach anyone tonight, the safest default is usually to skip the missed ones and restart your normal time tomorrow — but please confirm that with them. How are you feeling otherwise, aside from being wired?
